## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the lightweight [dcterms:hasVersion](http://purl.org/dc/terms/hasVersion) bridge between two resources where one is a version/edition/adaptation of the other and the WEMI tiers are not being modelled explicitly.

### Avoid when

- Avoid when the relationship is properly a WEMI realization/embodiment (use gmeow:realizes/gmeow:embodies) or a tracked version lineage (use the generic [`VersionSet`](../classes/gmeow-VersionSet.md)/VersionMembership machinery); avoid it for derivation ([`gmeow:wasDerivedFrom`](gmeow-wasDerivedFrom.md) subproperties).

### How to use

- Assert from the base resource to its version and read the inverse [`gmeow:versionOf`](gmeow-versionOf.md); promote to [`VersionSet`](../classes/gmeow-VersionSet.md)/VersionMembership when ordered or set-membership lineage is needed.
